_comment: Generated by Phase B audit (sub-issue #2127). See audits/2026-06-10-mockup-design-intent-audit.json for source.
_state_mapping_note: 10 mockup error states (A–J) mapped to canonical Storybook states. stream-timeout → error (warn-colored SSE stall); ocr-fail → error (danger, low OCR conf <0.3); llm-503 → error (danger, provider 503 + retry strip); segmentation-fail → error (warn, OCR ok but no § pattern); ocr-low-conf → error (warn, conf 0.64 with highlighted regions); photo-blur → error (warn, client-side pre-OCR blur reject); translation-timeout → error (warn, AI translate abort >20s); source-lang-unknown → error (danger, lang conf <0.5 dialog); network-mid-ocr → offline + error (danger, connection lost mid-upload, IndexedDB queue); quota-exhausted → quota-hard (warn/danger bridge, token quota 100%). All 10 variants are real conditions the app can hit — design_intent forward-refactor as the unified ErrorStatesMock banner pattern does not yet exist as extracted real components.
